name: What is the process for replacing a rotted window frame?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing a rotted window frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an inspection to assess the extent of the rot. Next, the affected window frame components and any compromised surrounding materials are carefully removed. This may involve cutting out sections of the old frame and potentially some siding or trim. New frame components, often pre-fabricated or custom-cut, are then installed, ensuring proper leveling and sealing. Finally, the area is sealed with caulk, flashing, and weather barriers, and any removed trim or siding is replaced, followed by painting or finishing to match the existing exterior.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, removal of rotted components, installation of new frame sections, proper sealing and flashing, and finishing to match the exterior.
